confusions: On the Year by year page I could not tell which country people visit most on holidays abroad, so I gave up on that one.
On the Year by year page the class size is shown for the latest year and I could not afford the taps to pick 2019, so my answer on that was a guess.
On the spending page the Cash, After inflation and Share of GDP buttons made me unsure which figure I was looking at.
